Web search (junior/entry-level remote worldwide AI, automation and Python roles)
Employer pages: MacroCoderz careers, Ashby API (Optimum), Lever API (Xsolla), UN Careers API (UNEP), LinkedIn guest job pages, Himalayas API (Xperteez)

method.filtering_summary: Live search at 7:31 AM EAT on 11 sources (all answered) pulled 2,226 postings: 1,769 were older than 7 days, 206 senior or excluded titles, 169 not target roles, 47 excluded Kenya, 1 already applied and 14 duplicates. Of the 20 that passed, 13 had already been shown in earlier briefings or reviewed, and the 7 new ones were dropped after a close look (French hybrid roles, a medical-device QA job, a plant engineer, a Drupal consultancy and an unverifiable AI-training contract). A same-morning web search found 5 new junior-friendly roles posted Oct 10-11, each confirmed live on the employer's own page. Nothing old was carried over.

jobs.title: Python Developer
jobs.location_as_stated: "Remote (worldwide)"; "fully remote and open to applicants worldwide"
jobs.experience_asked: Entry level, 0-2 years; recent graduates with real projects welcome

stories.title: xAI releases Grok Voice 3.0 speech-to-speech model
stories.summary: Grok Voice 3.0 scores 86.9 on Artificial Analysis's Speech-to-Speech Index and is in the Voice Agent API at $0.08 per minute, the same price as Grok Voice 2.0; grok-voice-latest agents were switched over automatically.
stories.why: Voice agents for customer support are a growing automation niche, and this one is a drop-in API upgrade.

stories.title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 ships open weights with day-0 AMD support
stories.summary: ModelBest's MiniCPM-V 4.7 multimodal model comes in 1B and 35B-A3B variants for on-device inference, validated at release on AMD Radeon GPUs, Ryzen AI Max and Ryzen AI NPUs via ROCm and llama.cpp.
stories.why: Small open-weight vision models he can run locally are useful for prototyping document and image steps in pipelines.

stories.title: Builder.io open-sources Agent-Native framework for agentic apps
stories.summary: Agent-Native beta is an open-source TypeScript framework where each agent gets its own UI, and one action definition is exposed to the UI, agent, HTTP API, CLI, MCP and A2A.
stories.why: It combines React, MCP and agent tooling, the same mix of skills his target roles keep asking for.

stories.title: Chainguard Checks turns CI into a tool call for coding agents
stories.summary: Chainguard announced Checks, a continuous verification engine that runs CI as a tool call inside agentic development loops and returns signed results in seconds, before code reaches a pull request.
stories.why: Shows where AI-assisted engineering workflows are heading, an area he already works in daily.

stories.title: Bisedge gets EUR 10M from Finnfund for electric forklifts
stories.summary: Finnfund committed EUR 10 million in senior debt to Bisedge to expand electric forklift fleets in Nigeria, Tanzania and Kenya, its first electric-vehicle investment in Africa.
stories.why: A logistics-as-a-service company scaling into Kenya with fresh capital may add local tech and ops roles.

stories.title: Kuunda closes oversubscribed $5M secondary share sale
stories.summary: Embedded-credit fintech Kuunda completed a US$5 million secondary sale led by E4EAfrica, with Accion Ventures, Portugal Gateway Fund and Seedstars Africa Ventures raising their stakes.
stories.why: Kuunda builds mobile-money float and merchant lending infrastructure, close to the fintech credit work he did at Kwara.

stories.title: Netflix cuts about 1,000 jobs
stories.summary: Netflix is laying off about 6% of staff, close to 1,000 people, mostly in product, tech, legal and HR, while saying it remains on track for its full-year forecast.
stories.why: Another large cut in product and tech roles adds experienced engineers to the remote applicant pool.

stories.title: a16z lays off most of its portfolio recruiting team
stories.summary: Andreessen Horowitz laid off the majority of its 34-person team that helps portfolio companies recruit, moving the rest into specialised investment groups.
stories.why: A sign that startup recruiting support is thinning, so direct outreach to founders matters more.

stories.title: Airtel Money plans a Mastercard virtual card in Kenya
stories.summary: Airtel's fintech arm will launch a Mastercard virtual card number tied to Airtel Money wallets, competing with M-PESA GlobalPay; M-PESA's share slipped to 88.8% in June 2026 while Airtel Money's rose to 11.1%.
stories.why: More competition in Kenyan mobile money means more payment-integration work for fintech engineers.
